name: Tether
description: Inbound Tether delivery for OpenClaw plus outbound Tether MCP tools.

agent.label: Tether Agent Name
agent.help: Agent name used for inbox lookups and ping registration.

sessionKey.label: Fallback Session Key
sessionKey.help: Used when no active OpenClaw session has touched the plugin yet.

lane.label: Gateway Lane
lane.help: Queue lane used for inbound Tether notifications.

notifyUrl.label: Notify URL
notifyUrl.help: Public or local URL Tether should POST to. Overrides TETHER_NOTIFY_PORT-derived URL.

notifyPath.label: Notify Path
notifyPath.help: Primary plugin-owned ingress path under the OpenClaw gateway.

mcpPath.label: Tether MCP Path
mcpPath.help: Path to tether/mcp_server.py. Usually left unset.

dbPath.label: Tether DB Path
dbPath.help: Path to the Tether SQLite database passed through as TETHER_DB.

autoRegisterPing.label: Auto Register Ping
autoRegisterPing.help: Register the plugin endpoint with Tether on plugin load.

mcpTimeoutMs.label: MCP Timeout (ms)
mcpTimeoutMs.help: Timeout for each outbound Tether tool invocation.

agent.description: Tether agent name used for inbox defaults and ping registration.

sessionKey.description: Fallback OpenClaw session key for inbound Tether notifications.

lane.description: Gateway queue lane for inbound notifications.

notifyUrl.description: Explicit callback URL to register with Tether.

autoRegisterPing.description: Register the notify URL on plugin load.

mcpTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for outbound MCP tool calls.
